# `assets/` — Every visual in the repository

**What is in here.** README and report images by kind: `figures/` (plots and panels), `gifs/` (looping clips), `renders/` (Webots captures and video posters), `diagrams/` (schematics), `decisions/` (one image per ADR).

**How it is produced.** Generated by `scripts/make_figures.py`, `scripts/make_visuals.py` and `scripts/make_clips.py`. Nothing here is hand-drawn or stock.
